name: depict
description: An Agent Skill that explains a concept by drawing it: a hand-drawn board that builds stroke by stroke and stays explorable.
author: David Estévez

scripts.examples: for b in skills/depict/examples/*/board.mjs; do node skills/depict/scripts/build.mjs "$b" --out "${b%board.mjs}$(basename "$(dirname "$b")").html" --audit || exit 1; done
